headline: Peria Karamalai Tea files September quarter financial results
summary: The Peria Karamalai Tea & Produce Company Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance update for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail shareholders and investors can review the earnings data directly on the exchange portal to assess operational margins and profitability trends. Small-cap agricultural stock disclosures help track sector-specific commodity pressures and plantation economics.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data released for retail shareholder review.

headline: Peria Karamalai Tea submits annual general meeting minutes
hook: AGM minutes filed for Peria Karamalai Tea
summary: The Peria Karamalai Tea & Produce Company Limited has submitted the official minutes of its Annual General Meeting held on September 26, 2026, to the exchange. This routine filing documents the formal proceedings and shareholder resolutions passed during the meeting. Such procedural disclosures are standard regulatory requirements for listed entities. Retail investors can access the documentation for corporate governance transparency.
why_it_matters: Routine governance update with no direct impact on stock price.
